name: go-deep-service-review
description: Multi-agent review of a Go service for a closed set of production defects: context propagation, IO without timeouts, decisions on untyped errors, unchecked batch partial failures (e.g. SQS), resource lifecycle (tx rollback, rows.Err, unclosed bodies/rows/readers), goroutines that cannot stop, app setup init/close order, SQL write pitfalls. You pick the checks; every finding carries its verification evidence.
